name: Drawer
summary: Modal side-panel composition with physical right and left placement, required named content and canonical dismissal, scroll partition, and target-owned focus, inertness, and lifecycle.

anatomy.name: overlay
anatomy.description: Backdrop layer that dims content behind the drawer.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Fixed side panel that owns placement, surface, shadow, and slide motion.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Top region for the required visible title and canonical dismiss action.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Required visible title used by aria-labelledby.

anatomy.name: close
anatomy.description: Required named dismiss action composed with canonical Close Button.

anatomy.name: body
anatomy.description: Scrollable primary content region inside the drawer.

anatomy.name: footer
anatomy.description: Optional bottom action or summary region.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Default drawer width and viewport bounds.

states.name: closed
states.description: Hidden side-panel state. Variant-specific selectors are implementation coverage of this same state.

states.name: open
states.description: Visible drawer state. Variant-specific selectors are implementation coverage of this same state.

states.name: scrollingBody
states.description: Long primary content scrolls independently between fixed header and footer.

behavior.name: visibility
behavior.description: The target keeps closed content unavailable and applies is-open plus aria-hidden=false when presenting the drawer.

behavior.name: placement
behavior.description: The default placement slides from the right; the left variant changes the resting and open transform direction.

behavior.name: dialogSemantics
behavior.description: The drawer should expose modal dialog semantics when it blocks interaction with the page behind it.

behavior.name: focusManagement
behavior.description: Opening from an invoker moves focus inside, contains Tab and Shift+Tab while modal, and restores focus logically on close.

behavior.name: dismissal
behavior.description: The drawer provides a visible named dismiss action and closes on Escape; backdrop dismissal remains target policy.

behavior.name: targetLifecycle
behavior.description: The target owns trigger relationships, inert background, page scroll locking, mutual exclusion, exit completion, and cleanup.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Visible localized title that supplies the dialog accessible name.

properties.name: content
properties.description: Primary content composed inside the scrollable body.

properties.name: dismissAction
properties.description: Visible native dismiss action composed with canonical Close Button.

properties.name: dismissLabel
properties.description: Contextual accessible name for the dismiss action.

properties.name: footer
properties.description: Optional persistent summary or canonical Button actions below the scrolling body.

properties.name: placement
properties.description: Side from which the drawer enters.

properties.name: open
properties.description: Controls visibility of both the drawer and its backdrop. Consumer targets still own focus management and dismissal behavior.

accessibility: Treat the v1 Drawer as modal: use role="dialog" and aria-modal="true" only while page interaction is actually blocked.
Use the required visible title through aria-labelledby.
Move focus inside, contain Tab and Shift+Tab, and restore focus logically on close.
Close on Escape and provide a visible named canonical dismiss action.
Keep header and footer available while the body scrolls; do not obscure focused content.
Use the physical left placement only when it matches the target product pattern; do not infer logical RTL remapping.
Honor reduced motion and preserve system boundaries in forced-colors mode.

web.notes: Canonical CSS implements physical side placement and scroll partition. The Web target maps modality through native dialog or equivalent focus/inert/dismiss behavior; the docs target demonstrates the lifecycle.

shopify.notes: Shopify Liquid can render drawer structure while theme JavaScript controls visibility and focus behavior.
